results.label: an unauthenticated caller cannot read the surface list or ask anything
the surface list is served with its refusals, its limits and its meta flags
the route surface is explicit: the channel answers POST /ask, and a GET to it is not a second read path
all seven surfaces answer over HTTP, each line carrying its provenance
the answer vocabulary stays the stated four kinds and nothing else
all six refusals are reachable, arrive as 200 successes, and carry their reason and citation
a refusal carries its reason and never the content it refused: no topic, no facts, no surface lines beyond the one note
every malformed question is a bounded 400 ask_invalid
a refused input never leaks a stack, a SQL fragment or an internal table name
a question that lands on no owned surface is an honest 200 non-answer that lists the surfaces it does own
the channel takes no account/date input: extras in the body cannot scope or move the answer
another owner’s workspace is never read: the second trader’s answers contain none of the first trader’s records or identifiers
two identical questions over HTTP answer the same bytes (deterministic, no clock-derived drift)
every HTTP answer ships the meta flags that refuse the AI perks
a full HTTP battery of asks leaves every table byte-identical, including the lazy practice timer row M108 creates on its own read
asking cannot move admission: the entry surface answers exactly the same before and after the whole battery
no ask ever stores the question, the answer or a consultation count: the request leaves no row of its own

scope: M109 ask channel API: actual runtime/auth/SQL/DOM on literal journals, fixedUTC; deterministic read-only advisory channel, no model/network/provider/broker/mental-state/pixel/production proof
